method.title: SOST in TNBC: reproduction
method.question: Do the two figures and the reported statistics in YangX-BIDD/TNBC (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.18752090) regenerate from the deposited code and data?
findings: Figure 2 reproduces: Pearson r = 0.571 over 798 pooled TNBC samples, as the README states
Figure 1 regenerates as deposited, but no deposited script produces the README's Q3 cutoff of 51.80 or its positivity rates of 25, 9.6 and 82.8 percent
